operator_glue_diagnostics.detail: Initial read-only exported-snapshot probe omitted docker exec -i. It exited before dump, target DB creation or AQ startup. Retained private empty preparation directory only.

Generated stage URL initially treated postgres as hostname, so peer authentication refused default OS user jkern before migrations. Corrected stage-only URL to reviewed helper form postgres://postgres@localhost/<newDB>?host=<actual private socket>. No authentication/socket policy weakening; same intended postgres identity, no canonical config change.

First actual owner startup stopped cleanly after probe failed parsing a SET command tag. Next stopped cleanly after an over-broad single-line JSON workaround mishandled multi-line PostgreSQL json_agg. Final parser strips only the explicit SET tag and preserves full JSON. No product/source/config/key/namespace changes or resets.
